name: Graphic Design
intro: Static work with a system behind it — posters, identities, editorial grids and social formats designed to stay consistent at any scale.
lede: Posters, identities and content systems where typography does the heavy lifting.

name: Motion & Video
intro: Movement with intent — title sequences, cinematic edits and vertical-first reels cut for rhythm, clarity and emotion.
lede: Editing, motion graphics and cinematic cuts built around rhythm and restraint.

name: AI Visual Lab
intro: A sandbox for generative filmmaking and image-making — where prompts become storyboards and models become collaborators.
lede: Generative films, image series and latent-space experiments treated with real craft.

name: Documentary & Film
intro: Stories captured rather than constructed — short documentaries, campaign films and the honest mess of making them.
lede: Short films, campaign storytelling and the behind-the-scenes truth of production.
